messages:
Marta (Eng Director): Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands Q&A: how do we reconcile sprint endings with the new biweekly majors? Should teams target a sprint boundary or the next release window?
Sam (VP Eng): Prefer teams target the next release window. Sprints still run normal, but feature owners must flag release tickets early so release engineering can slot work.
Kara (Product Ops): We need a short definition for PMs: 'major' = external API changes, data-migrations, billing, or infra-impacting features. Anything else is minor. I'll add that to the template.
Ibrahim (SRE): Operational constraints: majors need a canary >=4h, rollback playbook, and a 48h post-rollout watch. Also recommend a pre-freeze smoke run 24h before cut.
Jules (QA): QA checklist for majors: smoke pass, full regression on staging, top-200 prompt eval < 3% regression. I'll attach the quick run command below.
Tess (Eng Ops): I'll update the release ticket with fields: release_type, freeze_date, canary_window, rollback_contact, cs_notice. Also adding a short customer-notice template for majors.
deploy-bot: "Scheduled: canary at 09:00 UTC to 10% traffic. Monitor p95/p99, error_rate, and memory. Auto-rollback thresholds enabled."
Marta (Eng Director): @Jules please paste the eval command so teams can copy. Also who owns communicating to Dedicated customers?
Jules (QA): Copyable snippet: ```
# quick_eval.sh
python eval/run.py --prompts top200.txt --baseline baseline.json --cand build_123 --max_regression 0.03
```
I'll publish full harness in Confluence.
Ibrahim (SRE): Dedicated customers: Rohan's team will own opt-out windows. Ops, please ensure 72h notice for majors to Dedicated.
Tess (Eng Ops): Noted. Owners summary: Tess (ticket template + customer notice), Jules (QA checklist + harness), Ibrahim (canary/rollback rules + incident wiring), Kara (PM definition + template metadata), Marta (release policy owner). I'll circulate a 1-page RFC and schedule a 30m sync Friday 10am to finalize.
Sam (VP Eng): Leadership ask: keep majors predictable, minimize customer impact, and make hotfix path simple. Ops + QA + SRE to finalize RFC by Friday EOD.
Marta (Eng Director): Thanks all ; closing thread — will post RFC draft here when ready.
